title: Unit 10: Network Security
description: CIA triad, access control models, vulnerability categories, attack types and modes, prevention across OSI layers, NSM, security protocols (IPSec, TLS/SSL, SSH, PGP), and wireless security.
learning_objectives: Explain the CIA security triad and non-repudiation
Describe access control models and PKI
Categorise vulnerabilities and classify attacks by profile and mode
Explain prevention measures and security policies across OSI layers
Describe network survivability and the NSM process
Apply risk-analysis methodologies and SANS incident-response steps
Describe IPSec, TLS/SSL, SSH, PGP, and wireless security standards
